title: Stone Game VI
description: Alice and Bob take turns choosing stones. Each stone has a value for Alice and Bob. Maximize your own total value.
pseudocode:
1. combine = []
2. for i in range(len(aliceValues)):
3.   combine.push({sum: aliceValues[i] + bobValues[i], a: aliceValues[i], b: bobValues[i]})
4. combine.sort((x, y) => y.sum - x.sum)
5. aliceScore = 0, bobScore = 0
6. for i in range(len(combine)):
7.   if i % 2 == 0: aliceScore += combine[i].a
8.   else: bobScore += combine[i].b

steps.note: Sort stones by combined value descending: Stone 1 (sum 4), Stone 0 (sum 3)
Alice's turn: picks stone with sum 4 (value 3)
Bob's turn: picks stone with sum 3 (value 2)
